description: List products in a category with sorting and optional attribute filters.

category_id.description: ID of the category to list products from

sort_by.description: Sort field: name, price, created_at, or popularity

tags.description: Optional list of tag strings to filter by

condition.description: Optional product condition: new, used, or refurbished

rating_min.description: Optional minimum average rating filter; valid range 1–5

seller_id.description: Optional seller ID to scope results to a single seller

attributes.description: Optional arbitrary product attribute filters (e.g. color, size, storage)

include_out_of_stock.description: Whether to include out-of-stock products in the results; defaults to false

locale.description: Optional BCP47 locale tag used to localise product names and prices (e.g. en-US)
